newsitem.title: USA: Toro Co sees Q1 EPS of $0.10-$0.20.
newsitem.headline: Toro Co sees Q1 EPS of $0.10-$0.20.

text.p: Toro Co said Friday it expects its earnings for the first quarter ended January 31 will be between $0.10 and $0.20 a share.
Earlier, Toro said it expected earnings for the quarter would be below analysts' expectations, but did not make a specific projection.
Asked about the company's current projection for first quarter earnings, Toro spokesman Don St. Dennis said it was looking for $0.10 to $0.20 a share.
The First Call consensus for the first quarter was $0.37 a share, with a range of $0.33 to $0.43.
Toro said earlier that while its first quarter earnings will be below expectations, it said full-year plans and objectives are still on target.
The company said first quarter earnings were hurt by the early closing of its acquisition of John Hardie Irrigation Group, which shifted some expense into the first quarter.
In addition, Toro has added new business opportunities during the past year that continue to require significant investment.
